name: What is the typical cost range for a shower or tub upgrade?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a shower or tub upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a shower or tub upgrade varies significantly depending on the scope of work, materials chosen, and any necessary plumbing adjustments. Minor upgrades like re-tiling or fixture replacement can be less expensive, while a full demolition and re-configuration of the space, including moving plumbing lines, will incur higher costs. We provide detailed estimates after a site visit to assess your specific project requirements and discuss material options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for shower and tub upgrades vary based on scope, materials, and plumbing adjustments. A detailed estimate follows a site visit to assess your specific project.
